### Stack & Responsibilities
- Software Engineer II owning New Relic’s distributed Java query gateway. Building resilient multi-cloud database infrastructure for the company’s observability platform.
Software Engineer II building New Relic’s distributed Java query gateway for observability systems

- Participate in the on-call rotation

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Software Engineer II owning New Relic’s distributed Java query gateway. Building resilient multi-cloud database infrastructure for the company’s observability platform.
Software Engineer II building New Relic’s distributed Java query gateway for observability systems
Role description:
• Own the New Relic query gateway stack
• Participate in cross-functional committees and collaborate with AI, Visualizations, and Data Processing teams
• Build and maintain scalable distributed Java services and petabyte-scale infrastructure
• Investigate and resolve critical performance, availability, and resiliency issues in a multi-region, multi-cloud, multi-tenant distributed database
• Work in an agile DevOps environment
• Build and maintain the team's software
• Participate in the on-call rotation
• Respond to system failures
• Process systems handling millions of messages per second and petabytes of data
Role requirements:
• 3+ years of experience in collaborative software development
• Firm grasp of Computer Science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and modern software design and development methodologies
• Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership over code and commitments
• Ability to go deep on the command-line and fix things when broken
• Experience working in Java, or equivalent experience in an alternate OOP language such as C++, C#, etc.
• Visa sponsorship is not available
• Employment eligibility verification required
• Criminal background check required
• May be required to pass an export compliance assessment

Cloud, Java, C++
